title: Herb Infused Indian Sea Bass Curry
description: A malty and crisp Indian dish featuring sea bass fillets cooked in a tandoor style curry, FODMAP friendly and full of energizing flavors. This recipe is made in a traditional kadhai vessel.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a kadhai over medium heat until it reaches a temperature of 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 10 seconds.
Add the curry leaves and let them cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt, and cook for 1 minute until the spices are fragrant.
Add the ginger paste and cook for 1 minute until the paste is lightly browned.
Add the sea bass fillets and cook for 2 minutes on each side until they are lightly browned.
Add the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes until the sea bass is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve the curry hot over rice or with naan bread.
